messages:
alex_cs: FYI — TideFlow just escalated. After today's reranker rollout they see a sharp drop in recall and worse grounding/citations in production search. They included repro queries + expected doc ids. Asking for immediate investigation / rollback if needed. cc @maria_se @jamal_ml @patrick_eng

lucy_support: Customer summary (copied): "Top-5 correctness used to be ~87% on our test set, since the 09:12 deploy it's ~42%. Previously relevant docs are now ranked much lower or missing. This started right after your reranker update. Please revert if you can't find a quick fix." :frowning:

lucy_support: Customer attached two representative queries (redacted):
```
Query 1: "How do I rotate my API key with scoped permissions?"
Expected top doc ids: [doc_1234, doc_5678, doc_9012]
Actual top doc ids: [doc_9987, doc_4520, doc_1234]

Query 2: "Error 403 when calling /v1/embeddings - troubleshooting"
Expected: [doc_222, doc_333, doc_444]
Actual: [doc_333, doc_7777, doc_8888]

For Query 1 the correct doc moved from position 1 -> 3, for some queries it disappeared from top-10 entirely.
They also sent a small CSV with 150 labeled queries (precision/recall numbers attached).
```

deploybot: Reranker deploy event: reranker-v1.20 promoted to prod at 2026-03-17T09:12:07Z (canary -> full). Artifact: reranker-v1.20-quant. Notes: updated pairwise loss weight, changed score_threshold from 0.12 -> 0.18.

maria_se: Can someone confirm which vector index version the customer is querying against? Any index rebuilds or shard moves in the last 48h? Need retrieval traces + top-k distances for the failing queries.

alex_cs: Customer is on Hosted (prod). They say index version reported in their telemetry is idx-v2.7. No customer-side index rebuilds on their end. They attached retrieval traces showing lower cosine sims: positives dropped from ~0.78 to ~0.61 in many cases.

jamal_ml: Quick hypoth: raising score_threshold in reranker could suppress borderline positives after rescoring. Also pairwise loss change can alter ordering; small calibration shift -> big top-k churn. Can we run the same inputs through v1.19 and v1.20 to compare raw reranker logits and final scores? I want a diff of positives where raw retrieval still has high sim but reranker penalizes.

alex_cs: Repro steps I asked from the customer (they provided):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retrieval/query \
  -d '{"query":"How do I rotate my API key with scoped permissions?","top_k":20,"index":"idx-v2.7","include_scores":true}'
```
Response snippet (customer):
```json
{
  "results": [
    {"doc_id":"doc_9987","score":0.64},
    {"doc_id":"doc_4520","score":0.58},
    {"doc_id":"doc_1234","score":0.31}
  ]
}
```
Then they showed reranker outputs where the reranker assigned negative deltas to previously-high docs.

patrick_eng: If prod reranker v1.20 is the cause, we can rollback the reranker artifact to v1.19. For hosted customers that's a global change unless we pin. Immediate question: do we do a global rollback or try a targeted mitigation (lower score_threshold back to 0.12)? Which is faster?

jamal_ml: Lowering score_threshold to previous value is the smallest-change mitigation. But the pairwise-loss weighting change might still reorder. For fastest rollback, revert to reranker-v1.19. I can validate diffs on the 150-query set in ~10 mins if you give me run access to the sample CSV.

deploybot: traffic: reranker-v1.20 reached 100% traffic at 2026-03-17T09:14:20Z. Noted spike in rerank error logs (rate 0.3% -> 0.9%) and an increase in rerank latency p50 28ms -> 44ms for that period.

lucy_support: Customer is pushing: they want a rollback and will escalate to their legal/comms if not addressed in next 3 hours. They've paused their integration tests and flagged their status page.

patrick_eng: I'm initiating rollback to reranker-v1.19 now. Rolling back feature flag and promoting v1.19 artifact. ETA ~12m. I'll post when rollback completes.

jamal_ml: I'll run local scoring on the customer's CSV against v1.19 and v1.20 and share a small report (precision/recall + mean positive score delta). If we see big shifts, add a hotfix to recalibrate scores instead of full revert next time.

patrick_eng: rollback done — reranker-v1.19 is live at 2026-03-17T09:25:30Z. Canary confirmed at 100% v1.19.

lucy_support: Noted. I've asked the customer to rerun and share updated numbers. I'll relay results. :pray:

jamal_ml: Quick results from my run on their 150 queries: mean positive score (v1.19) = 0.412, (v1.20) = 0.291; number of positives dropping out of top-5 = 38 queries. I'll drop a CSV diff and a short notebook in the ml-repro bucket.

alex_cs: Thanks all. Action items: 1) lucy to verify with customer, 2) jamal to produce diff notebook + root-cause hypothesis, 3) maria to check retrieval index config and confirm no index drift, 4) patrick to schedule a controlled re-roll with a smaller canary + safe thresholds.

lucy_support: Customer confirmed rollback restored previous behavior on a quick smoke — their top-5 recovered to ~84% on the sample. They're relieved but want a postmortem before we try v1.20 again.

patrick_eng: I'll open an internal incident and tag eng-ml + eng-runtime for RCA.

deploybot: Incident created: INC-2026-8901 "Reranker v1.20 grounding regression" assigned to eng-ml.

alex_cs: Marking this thread resolved for CS once postmortem is shared. Thanks everyone.
